name: Nakasatsunai (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nakasatsunai village emblem in white and red: a white lotus-like wreath enclosing a red ring with the characters 札内.
history: Municipal flag of Nakasatsunai, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 September 1957.

features.role: Nakasatsunai village emblem — a white lotus-like wreath enclosing a red ring with the characters 札内
